summary.intent: Win the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' hackathon challenge for Soony: analyze the confidential supply-chain data drop, find where the Collector's/Standard launch really breaks vs. the 'all ok' plan, and build a general recheck-and-act agent product (poller, extraction, verification, Today/Launch UI, routines) before the Sunday 12:00 hand-in.
summary.outcome: Data analysis found real launch risks (overbooked art-book receipt, failed statue lot, sleeve revision conflict, offloaded game cards, false-alarm magnets). The ask-soony product was built with a poller, versioned store, paper check, data-shape check, Today and Launch pages, and a polished routines UI; 224 tests pass. Ask-the-site (packing/arrival/count) is still in progress, and 15 commits on jonas/today-flow remain unpushed awaiting approval.

repo: Portal API has only GET /api/v1/files, /files/{path} and /archive.zip, with no webhook or notification endpoint. Change detection must poll the file list and compare SHA-256, because existing files are replaced under the same name.
Confidential portal data, scans, drops and findings notes live in gitignored data/. .env holds SOONY_PORTAL_TOKEN (gitignored); .env.example is committed.
Teammates use CLAUDE.md and PROGRESS.md as a team workflow, and tasks are claimed with a 'Now' line in PROGRESS.md.
Entire hooks fire per turn but skip checkpoints when no repo files were modified; they only become a checkpoint at the first commit with changes.

Spreadsheets are recognised by columns, not file names, and bom_delta/components_update files are applied on top; a file whose columns are renamed is skipped silently unless the new datacheck catches it.
Stock numbers are book values (last count + receipts - backflushed consumption from the pack-out log), and the verifier parses last_count but doesn't use it.
Delivery site now derives from sites.csv instead of hardcoded 'Hamburg' in the paper check. The cutoff name is a per-customer server setting, but about 30 UI strings still say 'trucks'.
The server on :8000 runs uvicorn without reload, so it must be restarted after backend changes before the new Launch per-part data appears.
Today is the only case list; Plan was replaced by Launch (/plan redirects to /launch and /plan?card=X to /d/X).

code.finding: New module building the 'launch' field of /api/state (per-edition and per-part view from the verifier's dispatch.json and open_shipments.csv). Game card is shared across editions, so it has no run-dry time.
build_state() gained a 'launch' field (one import plus one line). Concurrent edits to this file by parallel builders risk clobbering it.
Run now on a routine in Tell me or Quietly mode really acts (can send emails). A confirm step was added after the polish builder flagged it.

workflow: Subagents (builders) can run in parallel, but editing overlapping files such as api.py and Today.tsx needs coordination; SendMessage is used to redirect a running builder.
Screenshot against a separate server on another port using a copy of the state, with non-GET requests mocked, to avoid real sends or paid LLM calls.
Keep confidential supplier data out of code and out of external services; share Claude artifacts only with the team.
Check whether others edited a shared doc before updating it, and ask before pushing or sending anything outward-facing.

friction: SOONY_PORTAL_TOKEN was initially empty, so the API returned 401 and blocked all data work until the user supplied it.
A circular import appeared when the datacheck module was first wired in and was fixed after running the real check.
The Entire log showed the SessionStart under a different session ID, and Codex hooks (7) still need approval in /hooks.
Several supplier drops arrived unannounced (five files in 37 minutes) with no notification mechanism; the Nowak offer has a 24h validity window.
The ask-the-floor builder and the routines builder ran concurrently and had to be told to avoid each other's files.
Editing a non-email message before approving was lost when the old Plan pane was removed.
Voice decisions have not been tested live with a microphone.
open_items: Push the 15 (earlier 10) local commits on jonas/today-flow; the user has not yet approved.
Finish and verify the 'ask the site' builder (packing count, arrival, inventory count via phone page with OCR), and make count requests feed the routines mechanism; check, commit and restart.
Act on the audit's top 3 gaps for the 6 risks and 7 process steps (results still to be reported).
Switch the remaining ~30 UI 'trucks' strings to the per-customer cutoff-label setting.
Backend wishes from the routines builder: weekly would-have-handled dry run, an undo-capable flag per action, and server-side look-alike grouping.
Pass the backflush insight (consumption is computed from the pack-out log) to the builder so a reported packing count also corrects book stock.
Register the team sender email in the portal Settings, and send the Karton Nowak art book order and the Boise EXW reply through the product.
Write the README, demo script and video for the 12:00 hand-in; put the vision items (probabilities, value-weighted question agent, supplier network) on the vision slide.
Decide whether to delete the earlier Claude doc now that the page exists, and consider changing the portal password shared in Discord after the hack.
Update the briefing page and doc, which still show the 14:00 state, with the 14:37 drop.
